item.title: Weelaunee Food Autonomy Festival
item.description: The movement to Defend the Atlanta Forest is seeing a surge of new energy with its fifth Week of Action (March 4-11), which will segue into the first annual Weelaunee Food Autonomy Festival (March 10-13). This gathering is organized at the site known as Weelaunee People's Park, threatened by a contested land swap to real estate developer and Hollywood investor Ryan Milsap.
